resources.string: AI Coach will analyze your training history (parts, actions, weights and sets) and recommend what to train today or what to do next. Data is only sent to the AI service when you tap the button below.
AI is analyzing your training history…

Add your DeepSeek API key in the AI Coach settings to enable recommendations. The key is stored only on this device, and training summaries are only sent to the AI service when you request a recommendation.
No train parts or actions exist yet. Add a train part and its actions first, then ask AI Coach for a recommendation.
Ignored suggestions not in your action library: %1$s
This part is enough for today
Based on your last %1$d training day(s), here is today\'s plan.
Today: %1$d set(s), current part: %2$s. What\'s next?
Invalid or unauthorized API key. Check the AI settings.
Network connection failed or timed out. Check your connection and retry.
Too many requests (rate limited). Please retry later.
The AI asked for more data even though no history could be provided and returned no plan. Please retry.
The AI still considered the data insufficient after expanding the training history and could not give a recommendation. Retry later or switch models.
The AI did not return a usable training plan. Please retry.
The returned plan could not be matched to your action library (it may contain unknown parts/actions). Please retry.
Could not determine the parts trained today. Please retry.
Could not determine the current training part. Please retry.
The current training part is not in your action library, so the advice cannot continue.
The AI suggested switching actions, but the suggested action is not in your library. Please retry.
